quests.chapter: 3rd Job - Step 1: Path of Tribulation (Lv.130+, TM 120+)
quests.title: Door of Tribulation - Path of Tribulation
quests.prereqText: Level 130+ (TM Level 120+ for the rest of the advancement)
steps: Buy 3x 1 Mil Galder Check from Andrew at Megalopolis Bank (1,050,000 Galder each).
Get a Ticket of the Valiant: dropped by Clurican (Lv.240) in 2nd Closed Lot of Jade Steel, or drilled in Swamp Dungeon.
Talk to the Door of Tribulation in the Garden of Skill Master and hand them in.

source.from: Clurican (Lv.240), or drilled in Swamp Dungeon
Andrew, Megalopolis Bank (1,050,000 Galder each)

quests.notes: Next, decide your 3rd job: each job has its own Guardian Stone quest (Step 2).
